tei:div.tei:p: "$ (285)༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog ras chung lugs kyi sgrub thabs bde chen ye shes thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(286)༄༅// na maḥshrī tsakra samba ra gu ra we/ rang byung bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i sku// dngos kun khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dang*// dbyer med he ru ka la gus btud nas// sgrub thabs zab pa'i yang snying 'dir dgod bya// sgrub pa po'i gang zag dbang gis rgyud smin cing dam tshig la gnas pas sgrub gnas dur khrod sogs rgyud dang mthun pa'am dben cing byin rlabs dang ldan par sgrub rdzas dam tshig gi bris sku sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang phyi nang gi mchod pa'i yo byad rnams nye bar bsdog /dus yar mar gyi tshes bcu sogs la dbu brtsams te stan bde bar 'khod/ mdun du ḍā ru rdor dril nang mchod rnams bzhag go /nyams len bya ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba dang*/ sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'o// dang po ni/ gtso bo dkyil chog dang 'brel ba yin kyang*/ sgrub pa ched du 'dzugs pa sogs la sgrub thabs kyi thog mar dgos gal che zhing dkyil chog dang 'brel na'ang sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba ni dkar bgegs spyi ltar bsham/ oṃ gyis gtor ma mi dmigs te stong par bsam/ āḥyis rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar bsam/ hūm̐ gis zad mi shes pa'i 'dod yon lnga ldan tu gyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum dang bcas pas byin brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i (287)hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis gtor mgron rnams spyan drangs/ sa ma ya dzaḥ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsi un mā da a pa smā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu ya thai paṃ ya theṣṭhaṃ bhuñdza tha dzi ghra tha pi pa tha mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta yā sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ye/ sa hā yi kā bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gis gtso byas pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la bsngo'o// 'bul lo// mgron no// sbyin no// bzhes nas dkar phyogs la dga' zhing skyong ba rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor bcas chos sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /gzhi bdag chen po la sogs pa'i// lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang*// 'byung po yi dwags sha za'i tshogs// smyo byed rjed byed mkha' 'gro ma// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ bar gyis phrin las bcol/ nag po'i phyogs la dga' (288)ba rnams kyang gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la/ sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa dang*/ dkar po'i phyogs la dga' bas/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig /gal te de ltar mi byed na sa phyogs 'dir ma 'dug par rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs shig /mi 'gro na ye shes kyi rdo rjes lus ngag thal bar rlog par byed do// zhes brjod cing rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing*// phrin las kun gyi bdag po ru// nga ni rjes su gnang ba ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /gal te bka' las 'das gyur na// brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za// oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān badzra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces drag rol dang bcas pas gtor ma phyir dor/ gnyis pa nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ zhes pas/ stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon gzhu bdungs pa'i dbyibs can chang zung dang mchog ma la yam̐ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar ba ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i zur rnams su kam̐ kam̐ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa rnams kyi steng du/ ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i steng du/ dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar du gau las ba glang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang po che'i sha /de rnams kyi steng du dbus su mu las dri chu/ shar du bi las dri chen/ lhor ra las rakta/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ byang du shu las byang sems te/ sha lnga (289)bdud rtsi lnga'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bo kha ṭwāṃ ga yu ba dngul chu lta bu las/ rtse mo dkar dmar mthing gsum 'od kyi rang bzhin can grub par bsam/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar bas thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams khol zhing zhu/ kha ṭwāṃ ga'i rtse las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku gsung thugs las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs kha ṭwāṃ ga la thim zhing*/ kha ṭwāṃ gas thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams dkrugs pas/ zhu zhing dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang*/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ rgya dang bcas lan gsum/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rdo rje spun rigs drug gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

lcer myong la/ rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum pa gnas khang dang mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sngar ltar bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi nang kun tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs te 'dod yon lnga'i mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ yul sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ dus thams cad 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du gnas pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ bkod pa mchog tu gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ltar bsam gyis mi khyab par mos la/ oṃ badzra ma hā ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ (290)dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ gi bar gyis sngags rnams rgya dang bcas pas byin brlab/ rol mo 'khrol la/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs nas/ āḥkhaṃ swā hā'i bar brjod / gnyis pa sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro la dang po spyi'i sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ rgyas pa na spyi ltar skyabs 'gro drug skor ci nus brjod/ bsdu na/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/

de'i ched du bdag gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshangs ba'i gnas bzhi sgom/ gnyis pa bye brag sa chog gi sngon 'gro blon po rigs gsum las byed la gsum las/ dang po rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pam̐ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa la yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin cing padma'i skyil mo krung gis 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar zhing 'od zer gyi klong du snang stong sgyu ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ(291)dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdor sems yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus phyi nang thams cad bkrus pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag cing dri ma med par gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya sogs he ru ka'i yig brgya dang*/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang bzla/

mthar/ mgon po bdag ni sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ rdor sems yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsams la mnyam par bzhag /gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus rdo rje la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog mthing gzhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo gri gug dang bdud rtsi'i thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yab rdo rje'i skyil krung dang yum padma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ka'ang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs shing dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ bkrag mdangs 'od zer gzi brjid rab tu 'bar ba gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams nas/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma/ yi dam lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad mdun gyi nam (292)mkhar byon par bsam/ oṃ gu ru maṇḍal de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ sngags snga ma'i mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra badzra ma hā ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ yab pā dyaṃ sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shabda 'i bar 'gres sbyar/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs shlo ka dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod/ sngags snga ma'i mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par gyur par mos la/ bdun rnam dag 'bul ba ni/

mchod 'os kun 'dus drin can bla ma la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa ma lus 'bul// dug gsum dbang gis sdig pa mtha' dag bshags// dus gsum dge la rjes su yi rang ngo*// theg gsum chos 'khor rtag tu bskor bzhin du// khams gsum 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol// dge bas 'gro kun sku gsum myur thob shog / ces dang maṇḍal tshogs bcad lhug gis phul/ de nas thun mong gi sdom pa bzung zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ skyabs gnas mchod 'os kun 'dus pa'i// dpal ldan bla ma dgongs su gsol// che ge mo zhes bgyi ba bdag /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni// ji srid byang chub ma thob bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin (293)yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs can dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba'i thog mar brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'don par gsungs pas rgyas bsdus gang rung 'don/ bsdu na/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// chos rje sangs rgyas bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi sku la= /bla ma kun khyab chos kyi sku la= /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la= /bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// ces gsol ba lan mang du btab/ dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yis// bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol// smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// lus la bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// bla ma'i gsung la gsol ba= /ngag la nus pa thon par byin= /bla ma'i thugs la gsol= /sems la rtogs pa 'char bar byin= /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la gsol ba= /sgo gsum dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros rang gi spyi bor thim/ sku las sku dpag tu med pa byung lus (294)la thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ldan tu byas/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ zhal nas sngags phreng dpag tu med pa byung ngag la thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/

ngag gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ lam gtum mo sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ldan tu byas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros rang gi snying gar thim/ thugs ka nas phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ lam pho nya sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ldan tu byas/ de nas bla ma yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur/ lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan tu

bsams la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rgyal po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i nyams len bsre 'pho skor gsum bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi gdams pa rnams yin pas gzhan tu shes/ dmangs phal pa phrin las mthun sbyor gyi rnal 'byor bdun 'dir bstan par bya ba yin pas/ dang po gsol 'debs skabs 'dir mi dgos/ gnyis pa bskyed rim la lnga'i dang po phyi dkyil sgom pa'i thog mar bgegs bskrad pa ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i mnyam gzhag gi ngang las/ snying rje chen po'i dbang gis rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams bkug cing steng 'og phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba sra zhing brtan pa ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de'i dbus su bhrūm̐ las (295)mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ kha dog ser po cher 'bar ba/ rtse dang dpal shin tu rno zhing khog pa stong pa'i steng 'og gi rtsibs gyen thur du zug cing me rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i nang gi dbus dang rtsibs bcu'i 'khor lo la ma reg pa'i bar snang rnams su pad nyi dbang phyug pho mo/ phyogs skyong bcu chung mar bcas pa dregs stobs nyams nas gan rkyal du 'gyel te/ rkang pa lcags sgrog gis sbrel zhing lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i gdan rnams grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog mthing nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gdug pa can thams cad kyi bdag po 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las skad cig gis khro bo brgyad spros te/ de yang shar gyi rtsibs su rdo rje drag po sngon po/ byang du rdo rje thabs sbyor ljang gu/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po/ lhor rdo rje nyi ma ser po/ shar lhor rdo rje 'jigs byed dmar po/ lho nub tu rdo rje stobs chen sngon po/ nub byang du rdo rje nag po nag po/ byang shar du rdo rje gnod sbyin dkar po/ thams cad kyang rab tu khros pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ba la sogs pa g.yas g.yon gyi phyag dang po gnyis na kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa/ de'i 'og ma lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ de'i 'og ma cang te'u dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la brgya byin la sogs (296)pa mnan pa/ de nas steng du rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po/ 'og tu rdo rje gnod mdzes sngon po zhal gsum phyag brgyad pa/ dang po gnyis na rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis na lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pa gnyis na mdung rtse gsum pa dang 'khor lo// bzhi pa gnyis na kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa 'chang ba/ g.yas brkyang bas tshangs pa dang sa bdag pho mo'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyang shin tu khros pa'i gzugs can thod pa dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i skur gyur/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ e hye hi/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ sngags snga ma'i mthar/ ārghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ shes rab zag med stong pa'i ngang nyid las// snying rje chen pos 'gro don dpag med mdzad// log 'dren bgegs tshogs thal bar rlog mdzad pa'i// dpal chen khro bo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/

ces pas bstod/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs= ma srin mkha' 'gro= sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i= rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ spyir zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra dang*/ khyad par dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyi mthu stobs brlag par gyur cig /nus pa nyams par gyur cig /drag shul dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyur cig /lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyur cig /rnam shes chos kyi (297)dbyings su sangs rgyas par gyur cig / ces thal mo lan lnga brdab/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ sogs/ slar yang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis se gol phyogs bzhir brdab cing*/ khro bo bcu gcig gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dgra bgegs rnams sgo gsum g.yo 'gul mi nus par gyur/ oṃ suṃ bha ni lan gsum brjod/ slar yang thugs ka nas stod khro bo smad phur bu'i rnam pa me 'bar ba dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros te/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu bkod par gyur/ phur bu tho bas bsdigs pa'i phyag rgya bca'/ oṃ bha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣṭāṃ bi ghnān hūm̐ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya badzra dhā ra ā dzña pa ya ti/ sarba duṣṭāṃ bighā na kā ya wā ka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra muṅga ra badzra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod pas/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi bar du phug nas/ srog 'od gsal du thim ste bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dang*/

phur bu rnams hūm̐ yig tu gyur nas khro bo rang rang la thim zhing*/ khro bo rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas dgra bgegs rnams 'khor lo'i rtsibs la bskyon zhing*/ 'khor lo g.yas phyogs su drag tu mi 'gul ba ltar 'khor bas/ mtshon cha'i char dang*/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang*/ me rlung gis dgra bgegs rnams rdul du brlag par byas/ rnam shes rnams yi ge a dkar po'i rnam par khro bo'i thugs kar thim pas chos kyi dbyings su sangs rgyas par bsam zhing*/ rab tu khros pa'i tshig gis/ oṃ kha badzra dhṛg badzra hūm̐ ka ra badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra a na lārka badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra uṣṇi ṣa badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kuṇḍa lī badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra yakṣa badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ma hā bā la badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kā la badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bhi ṣa ṇa badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra uṣṇi ṣa tsakra warti (298)badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra pa ta la badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ sngar ltar bstod/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba bskul/ de'i 'od kyis phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo brgyad bskul/ thams cad zhal phyir gzigs shing thugs ka'i 'od zer dang drag sngags kyi sgras dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams bkug nas 'khor lo'i rtsibs la bskyon/ mtshon cha'i char dang me rlung gis thams cad rdul du brlag /rnam shes a dkar po'i rnam pas khro bo'i thugs kar thim pas/ chos kyi dbyings su sangs rgyas par bsams la/ na maḥs manta kā ya wā ka tsitta badzra he ru kā nāṃ/ oṃ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka tsakra warti/ sarba lo ki ka lo kotta rā ṇi yant+ra mant+ra tant+ra tsūrṇa pra yo ga dī ni/ ye na ke na tsi ta tā ni sarba ni/ ā kaḍḍhya ā kaḍḍhya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya/

trā sa ya trā sa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ kṣ+māṃ kṣ+māṃ/ dzñau dzñau/ ma tha ma tha/ bi dhānsa ya bi dhwānsa ya/ sha ta sa ha sra/ tsūrṇa ya tsūrṇa ya/ oṃ phaṭa/ badzra he ru ka uṣṇī ṣa tsakra warti/ ta syai baṃmu khaṃ tsakṣu bandha bandha/ dgra bgegs byad ma gnod byed thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod rjes/ khro bo rnams thugs zhi bas 'khor lo yang mi 'gul ngar srung*/ khro bo rten bcas 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ rang yang 'od du zhu nas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su bsam mo// gnyis pa chos thams cad stong par sbyang ba ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bha ba ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ rang gzhan snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gsum pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams su e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs ka che ba gnyis kha sbyar zhing*/ rtse mo rno ba gnyis steng (299)'og tu phyogs pa'i nang du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam ljang sngon yam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri rab lhun po/ de'i steng du pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sna tshogs mdog can 'od du zhu ba las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir grub par bsam/ byin gyis brlab phyir/

oṃ me di nī badzrī bha wa badzra bandha hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de'i steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur gyis bkab par bsams la/ oṃ badzra pañdza ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ gur gyi nang du rdo rje'i bla bre grub par bsams la/ oṃ badzra bi tā na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ gur gyi phyi rol du rdo rje rtse dgu pa rwa rab tu gdengs pa rtsig pa'i ra ba grub par bsams la/ oṃ badzra prā kā ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ de'i steng du gnam lcags kyi thog ser la sogs mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char drag po phyir 'phro ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i drwa ba grub par bsams la/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzwa la tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba gur bla re rnams me'i rang bzhin du gyur pa las me 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur pa gyen du rgyug cing thur du 'tshubs pa dang*/ phyogs mtshams kun tu go 'tshams med par 'phyong bas dgra bgegs rnams sreg par byed pa'i ye shes kyi me drag por bsams la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes srung 'khor gyi sngags thams cad lan gsum brjod cing byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bzhi pa rten gzhal (300) yas khang gdan dur khrod dang bcas pa bskyed pa ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du bhrūm̐ sna tshogs mdog can 'od du zhu zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi'i nang nas rim pa bzhin du nag /dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang pa'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng na rin po che'i ba gam ser po'i ngos la chu srin mā ka ra'i kha nas do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bai ḍūrya'i bad kyi ngos la rin po che'i dra ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus yongs su bskor ba/ nang rdo rje'i gdung zlum pos khor yug tu bskor ba'i dbus su rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bris pa'i sna nas ka ba brgyad kyis rim pas bteg cing*/

dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thog gi rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ sgo rnams kyi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs 'og nas steng du rim pa bzhin du ser/ sngo/ ljang*/ dmar/ nag ser/ nag /sngo/ ljang*/ dmar/ dkar ba'i snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtser/ padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs te rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i stegs bu'i steng du lha mo bcu drug gi gdan dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i steng 'og gi lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser pa'i 'og dbus mthing ga 'phang mar gyur pa'i steng du/ sa 'og skyod sku'i 'khor lo dkar po mu khyud 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i steng du sa spyod gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po mu khyud padma'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i steng du mkha' spyod thugs kyi 'khor lo mthing ga mu khyud rdo (301)rje'i phreng bas bskor ba ste/ thams cad kyang rtsibs brgyad pa kun gyi lte ba ngo bo gcig las/ rnam pa'i kha dog rang rang gi mdog las steng 'og tu lhag par mngon pa sum brtsegs kyi steng ma/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo byang dang*/ dus mtshan dmar mo mgo bo lhor phyogs pa gan rkyal du 'gyel nas lag pa thal mo sbyar zhing rkang pa lcags sgrog gis sbrel ba'i gdan dang padma'i phyogs bzhir nyi ma ro'i gdan dang*/ mtshams bzhir bum thod bdud rtsis gang ba'i khar sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa re re/ 'khor lo rnams kyi rtsibs kun gyi nang dang sgo mtshams rnams su padma nyi ma ro'i gdan re re grub par

bsam/ gzhal yas khang pa'i phyi rol du khyams/ de'i phyi rol rdo rje'i gur dang ra ba'i bar du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar nas g.yon skor du/ gtum drag /tshang tshing drag po/ 'bar ba 'khrigs pa/ keng rus thod pa can/ shar lho nas g.yas skor du/ dpal gyi nags tshal/ mun pa drag po/ kī li kī li'i sgra can/ āṭṭa ṭe rgod rnams gnas pa/ de rnams su shing chen po brgyad/ sprin chen po brgyad/ ri chen po brgyad/ mchod rten chen po brgyad/ me chen po brgyad/ chu chen po brgyad dang*/ 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad mi ro dang rta ro dang sha khrag rus pas yongs su gang ba 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dur khrod chen po rnams grub par gyur/ lnga pa la bzhi'i dang po brten pa lha bskyed pa'i yan lag la'ang gsum gyi dang po gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon skor du dngul chu ltar gsal la 'tsher ba'i oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas skor du/ oṃ a ā

nas/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa'i bar/ phrag gnyis rnams 'od du zhu (302)las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ de'i dbus su thod pa raktas gang ba'i nang du/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ de'i steng du g.yas skor du rakta ltar dmar zhing snum pa'i ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ g.yon skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ nas/ ḍa ḍha/ zhes pa'i bar phrag gnyis rnams 'od du zhu pa las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur grub cing gsal ba ni/ sku mdog mthing gzhal bzhi las rtsa zhal mthing ga khros shing 'gyur ba/ g.yon zhal ljang gu rngams shing bsdams pa/ rgyab zhal dmar po cung zad zhi zhing chags pa/ g.yas zhal ser po gdangs shing bzhad pa/ zhal re re la'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer g.yo ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ tha ma gnyis zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ glang chen gyi ko rlon brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ḍā ma ru/ gsum pa na gri gug /bzhi pa na dgra st+wa/ lnga pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga/gsum pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ bzhi pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ lnga pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan gyi snying ga dang*/ g.yon cung zad bskums pas 'jigs byed kyi snying gar mnan nas rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i sku la khrag zhag thal chen gyis byugs pa/ dbu skra ral (303)pa'i cod pan gyi steng na sna tshogs rdo rje nor bu'i phreng ba dang*/

zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam gyi rtse rin chen 'bar bas spras pa lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs lhab lhub tu 'phyang ba la sogs te rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pas sgeg pa/ dregs pa pho mo gdan du bting bas dpa' ba/ sku che yan lag rags pas mi sdug pa/ ha hā dang hi hī la sogs te rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi bzhad sgra gad mor rgod pa/ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi nga ros drag shul dang ldan pa/ yan lag drug cu'i gdangs kyis log 'dren rnams spa bkong bar mdzad pas 'jigs pa/ rigs drug thugs rjes 'dzin pas brtse ba/ gdug pa can zhal du gsol bas rngams pa/ chos nyid ngang la bzhugs pas zhi ba ste/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das he ru ka'o// de'i pang na bde ba skyed pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo ni/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas sdigs mdzub gri gug dang bcas pas log 'dren rnams la bsdigs shing*/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho dar la bab cing bha ga dang nu ma rab tu rgyas pa/ bde ba chen pos rnam par myos pa'i cha byad can gyi zhabs gnyis padma'i skyil krung gis yab kyi sku la 'khril ba/ khro la 'dzum pa'i zhal mchi ba cung zad gtsigs shing mdzes la yangs pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes pa 'khor lo dang me tog gi phreng bas mdzes shing*/ lhag ma thur du grol bas rked pa non pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing*/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ thugs kar bam̐ (304)dmar po dang bcas pa'i bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid ma ste/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par

bsam/ gnyis pa nang gi 'khor bskyed pa ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra dang*/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin thig ler gyur pa gsang gnas brgyud de yum gyi mkha' nang du byon pas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i skur grub cing rdzogs pa yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir 'phros te rang rang gi gdan thog tu 'khod pa ni/ bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas dang po gri gug /gnyis pa na ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dang pos thod khrag /gnyis pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ khro la 'dzum pa'i zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing*/ mdzes la yangs pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes pa nor bu dang me tog gi phreng bas mdzes shing*/ lhag ma thur du grol bas rked pa non pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho dar la babs shing bha ga dang nu ma rab tu rgyas pa/ bde ba chen pos rnam par myos pa'i cha byad can gyi zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyi rol thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyi rtsibs/ pullī ra ma la yang khaṇḍa ka phā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang dzā landha rar ma hā kaṅka la dang gtum mig ma/ nub o rgyan du kaṅka la dang (305)'od ldan ma/ lho ārbu dar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me go dā wa rir su ra bai ri dang brtan pa'i blo gros ma/ bden bral rā me shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/

rlung de wī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ dbang ldan mā la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing gi grib ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o// de'i 'og gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs kā ma rū par myur gu can dang sa srung ma/ byang o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lhor ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lho ka liṅkar rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs lha mo/ lho nub laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po'o// de'i 'og sku'i 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang gṛ ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang du ma skyes ma/ nub sau raṣṭar rta mgrin dang shoṇḍi nī/ lho su warṇa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ me nā ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bden bral sindhū rar padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ rlung ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur bas/ dbang ldan ku lu tār rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo// de thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po ste/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa la g.yas dang po thams cad thugs kyi dpa' bo rnams rdo rje/ gsung gi rnams padma/ sku'i rnams 'khor lo 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dang po thams cad de dag gis yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum ral (306)pa'i cod pan stod cha gyen du brdzes pa'i rtse rang rang rigs bdag gi phyag mtshan dang nor bu'i phreng bas mdzes shing lhag mthur du grol ba/

thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol pa/ sgeg pa la sogs gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ padma dang nyi ma ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon cung zad bskum pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ yum thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes pa rim pa bzhin/ rdo rje/ padma/ 'khor lo rnams kyis mdzes shing*/ gzhan phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs 'khyud stangs rnams ni gtso mo dang mthun pa'o// de'i phyi rol lha snam dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ mer gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ bden bral du gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ rlung du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dbang ldan du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon spo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes pa ral gris mdzes shing*/ gzhan phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs bzhugs stangs rnams ni nang gi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang mthun pa ste/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nas gsum pa phyi'i 'khor bskyed pa ni/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer sku dang phyag mtshan yig 'bru thig le'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa gzhal yas khang pa'i phyi rol du 'phros te/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams khyams dang dur khrod kun tu khyab pas/ phyi'i 'khor dmangs lta bur gyur pa ni/ steng du me (307)tog dang bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs pa dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs te mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa la brtson pa'i lha'i bu dang bu mos gang ba/

'og mchod snam steng du mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha mo bcu drug mchod pa'i las la brtson pa/ khyams su rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs dang mchod rdzas kyis gang ba/ dur khrod brgyad kyi shing rnams kyi rtsa bar phyogs skyong*/ rtse mor zhing skyong*/ chu la klu chen brgyad/ ri la rnal 'byor pa chen po brgyad bzhugs pa'o// gtsang rigs kyi dpal mgon rnams kyang rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs bzhon par bcas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ 'dre dang srin po/ sha za dang smyo byed/ rjed byed dang ro langs rnams 'khrugs shing 'dzin ba dang*/ rgyug cing mchong ba dang*/ keng rus gar byed pa la sogs pa dang*/ seng ge stag gzig la sogs gcan gzan gyi tshogs dang*/ kaṃ ka dang khyung la sogs te bya'i tshogs rnams rnam par bam pa la sogs te ro'i tshogs rnams rngam par za bas gang ba ste/ mdor na rigs drug gi sems can rnams las dge sdig zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs la spyod pas gang bde thams cad gtso bo dpal he ru ka'i sprul pa'o// gnyis pa go cha bgo zhing sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i yan lag ni/ bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyi thugs kar oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpal dkar po g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpral bar na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu las padma gar dbang dmar po g.yas padma 'dzin pa/ phrag par bau ṣa ṭa he las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mig tu hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥlas rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ lhu tshigs thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las rta mchog ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar stabs su (308)'dzin cing g.yon thams cad de dag gis yu ba byas pa'i dril bu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'chang ba/ gcer bu dpa' bo'i rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon cung zad bskum pa'i rol stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi lte bar oṃ bam̐ phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral bar hrīṃ hriṃ skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las gtum mo dung ka /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'chang ba gcer bu dpa' mo'i rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa ste/ dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par bsam mo// de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsam/ gsum pa snod bcud sbyangs shing ye shes pa gzhug pa'i yan lag la gsum gyi dang po snod bcud sbyang ba ni/ lha rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang gzhal yas khang las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog gzhal yas khang du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pho thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ mo thams cad rdo rje phag mor gyur/ par bsam mo// gnyis pa ye shes pa gzhug pa la gsum gyi dang po spyan drang ba ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od dang*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing ngag tu/ pheṃ pheṃ zhes pa'i sgras mngon par dga' ba'i zhing la sogs (309)te rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho nas 'khor lo sdom pa drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ oṃ bha ga wān shrī he ru ka tsakra samba raṃ wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drang*/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ oṃ bha ga wā na shrī he ru ka tsakra samba raṃ wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ gsum pa ye shes pa gzhug pa dngos ni/ oṃ bha ga wā na shrī nas/ sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ ye shes pa dam tshig pa la thim pas dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bsgom pa ni/ skabs 'dir/ rang gtso bo dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar rtsa dbu ma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad dang*/ khams dmar po nyi ma/ dkar po zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du gong gi rlung sems dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon po 'od kyis nam mkha' gang nus pa zhig grub par gyur/ de dang 'brel bar lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ dam tshig sems dpa' 'khor lo drug dang rtsa chen rtsa phran ba spu'i bu ga rnams su/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ rigs lnga yab yum/ sems dpa' sems ma/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsam gyis mi khyab pa ri rab kyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa til gyi gong bu kha bye ba ltar lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal zhing rdzogs la grub pa nyid du gyur par

bsam mo// de nas bzhi pa dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i yan lag la gsum gyi dang po/ dbang lha spyan drangs shing gdan 'bul ba ni/ pheṃ pheṃ slar yang dbang lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla (310)ma dang mi bskyod pa dbyer med pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drang*/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ gyis padma'i gdan 'bul/ gnyis pa mchod bstod gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra ma hā ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe ā:hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai waṃ dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod cing*/ bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pas bdag cag rnams la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gsum pa dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan pa dngos ni/ rigs lnga'i 'khor rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs sgrog cing mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba dang bcas te lha tshogs rnams kyis/ he ru ka dpal 'khor bcas kyi// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi// sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyong byed pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lha thams cad kyi sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag /lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang ste yar lud cing spyi bor 'khyil ba rigs bdag tu gyur pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum la rdo rje 'chang yab yum/ nang gi lha mo bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi lha rnams la mi bskyod pa/

gsung gi lha rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku'i lha rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la don yod grub pa/ phyi'i lha rnams la rang rang rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan pa las/ dbang lha rnams rang rang rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan pa la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa mchod (311) pa la bzhi'i dang po phyi'i mchod pa ni/ bhrūṃ aṃ dzri khaṃ hūm̐ rnams 'od du zhu ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas bdag la mchod par bsams la/ oṃ āḥrū pa badzre hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shabda/ gandhe/ ra sa/ sparshe/ badzre hūm̐/ oṃ bha ga wā na shrī he ru ka tsakra saṃ bha ra bī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza hoḥ zhes sngags rgya rol mo bcas pas mchod/ gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhi'i bum thod bdud rtsis gang ba rnams las/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ lha re re'i phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byung ba rnams gsol bas lha thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis tshim par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ bha ga wā na shrī= sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta pū dza hoḥ zhes mtheb srin kyis bdud rtsi 'thor zhing 'bul lo// gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams dang*/ khyams dang dur khrod kyi 'khril sbyor can rnams snyoms par zhugs pas/ nang gi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la sogs te 'khril sbyor med pa rnams kyang ra ro ba'i zag med kyi bde ba myong bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ bha ga wān shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ma hā su kha gu hya pū dza hoḥ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ bzhi ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ bha ga wān shrī=

pa ri wā ra shū n+ya twa dzña na pū dza hoḥ zhes gnas lugs kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /bzhi pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gdan steng na// srid zhi mnyam sbyor 'khor lo sdom pa ni// mthing nag zhal bzhi bcu gnyis phyag dang ldan// gar dgu'i nyams ldan phyag rgya drug gis mdzes// shes rab 'khril (312)sbyor rdo rje phag mos 'khyud// drug cu la sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor// sgyu ma'i gar gyis sa gsum 'gro ba 'dul// 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod// lnga pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thog mar dbyangs gsal/ rten snying*/ yig brgya sogs kyis phreng ba byin brlab/ rang gi snying gar dhū ti padma 'dab brgyad sngon po'i steng du khams dkar po zla ba/ dmar po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po 'od kyis nam mkha' 'gengs nas pa/ de'i mthar thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa las grub pa'i yig 'bru/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yab kyi nye snying yi ge bdun pa dang*/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la samba raṃ swā hā/ zhes snying po yi ge nyer gnyis pa'o// de bzhin du yum la bam̐ gyi mthar/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ oṃ badzra be ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye snying gis bskor bar bsam mo// de bzhin du dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams la'ang*/ thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du dpa' bo rnams la hūm̐ dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams la bam̐ gyi mthar sngags gang bzlas pa des bskor ba las 'od zer kha dog rnam pa lnga 'phros pas/ dkar pos bdag gzhan gyi phyi yi nad gdon dgra bgegs sogs mi mthun phyogs rnams dang*/ nang gi nyon mongs pa zhi bar byas/ de bzhin du ser pos tshe dang bsod nams dge legs nyams rtogs rnams rgyas par byas/ dmar pos skye 'gro rnams dang rtsa rlung thig le rnams dbang du bsdus/

nag pos dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams dang bdud bzhi brlag par byas/ ljang gus phrin las kun gyi grogs su gyur par bsams la mdor bsdus re bzla/ rgyas par 'khor rnams rang rang gi sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā ma ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nang gi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags so// oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇḍa ka pā la phra tsaṇḍe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā kaṃ ka la/ tsaṇḍa tsakṣu ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhandha bhandha kaṃ kā la/ pra bhā wa tī (313)ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya bi ka ṭa daṃṣṭī ṇi/ ma hā nā se ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya su ra bī ra ni/ wī ra ma tā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ a mi ta bha wa/ kharba rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥhraḥbadzra pra bha/ laṃ ke shwa rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ badzra kā ya/ dru matstsha ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mo sogs rim pa bzhin thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi sngags so// oṃ phaṭa phaṭa aṃ ku re/ e rā wa tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha badzra dzā ṭa/ ma hā bhai ra bī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā wī ra/ wa yu be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ba sa ru dhi ra ānta mā lā ba laṃ bi ne badzra hūm̐ ka ra/ su ra bhakṣi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sapta pā ta la ga tā bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sa ra waṃ bā ta rdza ya su bha dra/ shyā ma de wī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā kaḍḍhya aḍḍhya badzra bha dra/ su bha dre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ma hā bhai ra wa/ ha ya karṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzñauṃ dzñauṃ bi rū pākṣe/ kha gā na ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ myu gu can dang sa srung ma sogs rim pa bzhin gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyi sngags so//

oṃ kṣ+māṃ kṣ+māṃ ma hā ba la/ tsakra be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hāṃ hāṃ ratna badzra/ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ ha ya grī wa/ shauṇḍi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ā kā sha garbha/ tsakra warmi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li shrī he ru ka /su wī rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li padma na rte shwar/ ma hā ba le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi li bai ro tsa na/ tsakra wartī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li badzra sa twa/ ma hā bīrya ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma sogs rim pa bzhin sku'i 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dpal mo rnams kyi sngags so// oṃ kā kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ u lū kā syai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā kā syai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su ka rā syai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma da ḍhīye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dū tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣṭī ṇi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khwa gdong ma sogs rim pa bzhin sgo mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ma brgyad kyi sngags so// (314)oṃ haḥ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ pau ṣa ṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥphaṭa phaṭa/ yab dpa' bo rnams kyi go cha'i sngags so// oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hre hrīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ yum dpa' bo rnams kyi go cha'i sngags so// oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags te de ltar gtso 'khor gyi 'gros ltar mang nyung skabs dang sbyar la bzla'o// de ltar sngags bzlas la dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug /'bring bzhi/ tha ma gnyis so// grangs yi ge bdun pa dang*/ yi ge nyer gnyis pa la 'bru 'bum/ 'bring yi ge bdun pa la 'bru 'bum dang snying po la 'bum phrag bzhi/

tha ma yi ge bdun pa la 'bum phrag bzhi dang snying po la nyis 'bum/ yum la sum 'bum bzhi khri/ 'khor rnams rab 'bring kun la khri tsho re re/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rang zhal mthong nas chos dbang lung bstan thob cing nyams rtogs skyes pa/ 'bring dam rdzas khol ba/ tha ma rmi ltas bzang po ma byung bar du bya'o// gzhan yid bzlas/ rlung bzlas/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ do li'i bzlas pa sogs bla ma'i zhal shes ltar bya'o// drug pa dang bdun pa/ thun mthar mchod bstod ni/ oṃ bha ga wān shrī he ru ka tsakra samba raṃ bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra ārghaṃ nas/ shabda pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ hūm̐/ pad nyi 'jigs byed sogs gong ltar gyis bstod/ brgyad pa bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas snang srid thams cad 'od du zhu ba dur khrod la sogs pa'i lha rnams dang gzhal yas khang rten dang brten par bcas pa la thim/ de yang gtso bo yab yum la thim/ de ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de gyen rdzogs thig ler yal ba'i ngang du mi dmigs par bsams la/ rtag mtha' bsal zhing*/ slar yang 'od gsal stong nyid de'i ngang las skad cig gis chu las nya 'bar ba'i tshul du rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur langs par bsams pas chad pa'i (315) mthar bsal zhing zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin chu bo'i rgyun lta bu la spyod par bya'o// thun mtshams kyi bya ba dmangs phal pa phrin las mthun sbyor gyi bya ba bdun las/ 'dir skabs su babs pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i gtor ma cha gnyis bshams la/ bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gtor mgron rnams byon par bsams la/ hūm̐/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku// spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang*// thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos skur dag pa las// ye shes sgyu mar rol te gshegs su gsol/

badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drang*/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ gtor mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ gu ru maṇḍa la de ba ḍā ki nī dharma pā la badzra dzo ka dzo ki ni sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba lyā dī swā hā/ de nas 'dod don gsol ba ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rdo rje spun la sogs pa'i skyabs gnas mchod 'os dam pa rnams bdag cag che ge rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag bsam pa nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis sbyor ba lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal bas/ dam pa khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang 'gal bar gyur te/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur cing mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad gnong ngo 'gyod do mthol lo bshags so// rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces dang*/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*/ sa lam gyi 'gal rkyen thams cad phyir zlog tu gsol/ mthun rkyen thams cad lhun gyis grub (316)ste tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' dag sbyang zhing dag nus pa dang*/ sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god nus pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ sngags tsam gyis mchod/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ sarba lo ka ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan gsum gyis bsngo ba dang*/ lha klu gnod sbyin sogs sngon gtor ltar phrin las bcol/ rten yod na gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa bstim/ rten med na/ badzra muḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs/ 'jig rten pa rnams la/ 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam/ zhes shlo ka gcig dang*/ sarba bhū ta gatstsha sa gshegs par bya/ bsngo smon dang shis brjod gang rung bya'o// byin rlabs gzi brjid dus kyi mtha' 'dir yang*// nyams med tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'bras ster ba// ma rgyud yang snying sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas// sa steng kun khyab 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /ces pa'ang gdams ngag mdzod bka' brgyud rin po che'i khrid rim rnams kyi smin byed du bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ mkhan chen bla ma rin po che karma bkra shis 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa'i sde'i zhal snga nas gsung bskul gnang ba ltar/ ris med kyi bstan pa la gus pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang pos rtsa ba'i yi ge gtsang smyon he ru ka'i nor bu skor gsum dang mthun par shrī de bī ko ṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su rang lo gya bdun par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa blo gsal gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
